peer_policy_contract.horizon: Maintain the same repositories, accepted ancestry and role journals through every release; do not reset agents between feature tickets.
peer_policy_contract.independent_candidate_boundary: First alternatives are blind to sibling source until a prospectively fixed proposal boundary; later evidence exchange is explicit.
peer_policy_contract.integration: Peer/model decisions select a whole candidate before narrow common merged-tree validation and fenced promotion; arrival order is not an undeclared source-selection policy.
peer_policy_contract.task_choice: Peers choose eligible locally arrived work; the common authority checks leases and budgets but does not select the task.
peer_policy_contract.task_discovery: Admissible newly discovered dependency/contract work, allowed scope and identity derivation must be specified before execution.
peer_policy_contract.task_identity: Requirement/work-item identity is distinct from each candidate-lane leased task ID.

resource_proposal.allocation: Aggregate opportunity matching rather than equal per-agent quotas. All planning/test-design/implementation/review/repair calls count. Soft stage allocations may be reassigned by the fixed policy within common hard limits.
resource_proposal.capacity_scaled_followup: A study giving each of 16 builders the same allowance as each of four builders offers extra aggregate compute and must be separately labeled/registered.
resource_proposal.do_not_force_utilization: Do not create work merely to fill roles; report empty ready frontiers, idle agents and duplicate alternatives.
